items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: For him it was a little too out, I would say. He was very nice, but he didn’t buy.

ctx.x: It was Benny Goodman. Benny – I think I – yeah, I must have had a tape of the piece. For him it was a little too out, I would say. He was very nice, but he didn’t buy. But the piece was recorded anyway with Buddy DeFranco and first heard 20 years later.
Why did they take so long to release it? What’s your feeling about it?
